channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Zach Edey | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Zach Edey from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Donovan Clingan on Zach Edey
item.description:
Donovan Clingan on playing against Zach Edey for the first time in the NBA:

“It was good. He got a lot of hate coming in, of people questioning how he’d be in the NBA.So for him to be executing at a high level, I’m proud of him.”

Donovan Clingan on Zach Edey, Nov 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Zach Edey
item.description:
Marcus Smart on Zach Edey:

“Huge, man. He’s gonna be huge for us. He allows us to do a lot of different things on the defensive end. He lets me and Jaren really give everything we’ve got. Being former Defensive Players of the Year, it’s great to have that rim protection behind us. And being 7-4 definitely helps with that. He moves very well, his IQ is very high, and he’s only continuing to get better.”

Marcus Smart on Zach Edey, Oct 9, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Zach Edey
item.description:
7'3 Kristaps Porziņģis on Zach Edey, responding to a question from @Hunter_Bailey45:

Kristaps Porzingis on Zach Edey, Apr 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.
